changelog:
- Initial release of vistoya-fashion-shop skill.
- Enables searching and recommending real fashion products and brands from thousands of online stores via Vistoya MCP.
- Supports natural-language queries, structured filters, similar-item lookup, multi-currency pricing, and direct merchant links.
- Provides dedicated tools for product and brand discovery, as well as catalog-aware filtering.
- Strict rules: no inventing product details, render API prices accurately, and always include merchant links for recommendations.
